known_previous_results: geometry-v3.1 FAIL oracle and unsupervised; retained unchanged; method correction is not a search for PASS

geometry.centre: exact final member mean; fitted centre diagnostic only
geometry.sphere_covariance: rms_radius_squared times I; floor1e-6 purely SPD safeguard
geometry.sphere_inside: Euclidean distance strictly less than kappa times RMS radius
geometry.ellipse_inside: Mahalanobis distance strictly less than kappa
geometry.recognition: overlap>=T and best-minus-second>=M; deterministic greedy one-to-one remains explicit disclosed conflict policy
geometry.birth: best overlap<T only when both T and M strictly separated; otherwise calibration_unknown without identity/birth/death claims

rolling_drift.disclosure: Original specifies sliding average but no width/alpha; fixed alpha=.5 is prospective implementation choice, not historically specified constant

m3.split: >=2 current clusters geometrically contained in previous cluster; no contained current cluster has member-Gaussian overlap>=frozen T with parent; veto independent M2 margin/conflict/dormancy/recognisedID
m3.merge: current cluster contains >=2 previous clusters; no composition or recognized-ID eligibility filter
m3.comparison: strict containment>0.60; strict distance<2.5; M2 overlap/margin inclusive
m3.truth_matching: Evaluator matches previous/current cluster geometric events via fixed subject_map, not M2 recognised IDs; truth never enters detector

calibration.T: midpoint(q05 self, q95 other) ONLY q05 self > q95 other
calibration.M: midpoint(q05 positive gap, q95 negative gap) ONLY q05 positive > q95 negative
calibration.positive_gap: own bootstrap BC - max competitor BC, true source identity excluded from competitors
calibration.negative_gap: max competitor BC - second competitor BC; true source identity excluded; second=0 when exactly one competitor
calibration.missing_or_nonfinite: INCONCLUSIVE; null affected threshold, no fallback or confident recognition/birth/death; full geometry/labels/mask and descriptive M3 retained
calibration.overlap_or_equality: INCONCLUSIVE; null affected threshold; no threshold selection based on observed control quality
calibration.raw_output: all self/other/positive/negative bootstrap scores; all quantiles/counts, individual strict-separation flags
calibration.gap_reference_disclosure: positive/negative calibration competitor count excludes true source; recognition best-minus-second uses every eligible historical identity, including potential true identity; these are distinct reference universes, not equal statistics
calibration.Tc: q50 other diagnostic only; null if missing; never a gate
calibration.quantile_choice: q05/q95 and midpoint prospective implementation choice fixed before new calibration, not literally specified quantiles in KB74
calibration.independent_thresholds: Each T/M midpoint exists only when its own two pools strictly separate; overall qualification requires BOTH. If M undefined but T valid, M2 remains unknown and M3 overlap>=T veto remains independent of margin. If T undefined, split/merge geometry saved as unqualified.

controls.generator: one fixed point bank per seed/world; literal union/repartition at month14 split/merge; fixed member IDs, no redraw; otherworld deterministic changes; same fixed anisotropic transform
controls.point_conservation: split and merge every point coordinate byte-exact across all months; labels alone repartition or union

error_budget.applies_to: primary Mfactor1 separately for oracle AND unsupervised; both must pass to report technical synthetic acceptance
error_budget.confidence: pooled empirical counts for this fixed suite; report bootstrap intervals descriptively, not population control
error_budget.sensitivity: all factors reported; sensitivity failures prevent robustness claim but do not permit selecting alternateM
error_budget.NA: any primary rate denominator0 or missing configs yields INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS

report_rules.ARI_NMI: saved exact territory join adjacent months; no new clustering
report_rules.recognition_fraction: recognised continuing+reemergence region decisions / all postinitial region decisions; separate MOweighted ratio
report_rules.lifespan: observed span + occupied months + censored flags; unidentified ambiguous clusters excluded explicitly
report_rules.spec_gap: classify saved events overlap>=T AND margin<=M for previous strict tracker; conflicts explicit, missing fields UNKNOWN
report_rules.M3: separate M3-only from combined birth/death events; sensitivity matched rates UNKNOWN if absent
report_rules.unqualified: All full mask remains calibration_unknown; raw geometric M3 candidates separately unqualified, never economic/scientific PASS; event truth misses retained and no-prediction FDR null
